attr.title: Ashworld (experimental)
attr.desc: Experimental desktop Java/libGDX adaptation for ARM64 Linux handhelds. Uses the owner's unchanged Windows game JAR, native ARM64 libraries, offline play and PortMaster keyboard controls. Hardware testing is required.
attr.inst: Copy your supported Windows/GOG ashworld.dat to ashworld/ashworld.dat. No EXE, APK, conversion or asset extraction is needed. Install PortMaster's Westonpack and Java 17 runtimes. On muOS place ashworld in /ports and Ashworld.sh in /roms/PORTS. Other firmware normally keeps the script beside ashworld in its ports folder. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and graphics drivers.
